Description

Lovely cottage style villa located in the nice and quiet area of Pererenan is now available for monthly rental. The villa built on 250 sqm of land size. The villa consists of 1 en-suite bedroom, extra room can be used as bedroom or study room, equipped kitchen with open living space, garden, pool and parking area.

The design of the villa is suit perfectly with the weather in Bali. Rent this beautiful villa and feel the comfort and warmth as well as privacy during you and your loved ones stay. Walking distance to the nearest beach and also short drives to many attractions in Canggu. For anyone of you who are looking for villa in Pererenan for long-term rental, this villa is the perfect one for you. Villa Pelangi is available for monthly rental.
